item.description: - In Overview, swipe left or right with four fingers to go to the next or previous workspace. Outside Overview, four fingers left / right still carry the focused column. Needs Raw trackpad touches in Settings › Gestures. - Smoother with Meeting Privacy on: Butterfly does less work behind private-window glass, so screen sharing and clicking in other apps stay responsive.

- Meeting Privacy no longer turns on by itself during calls. To blur private windows automatically in every call, turn it on in Settings › Meeting Privacy. - The tour now shows Meeting Privacy with a switch, so you can turn automatic blur on or off right there. - The shortcuts that cover the window in front or every private app work as before.

- New gesture tour: one gesture per step, with a preview of the move and a test area where you try it yourself. Next unlocks once you've done the gesture, Skip tour is always there, and closing the window pauses the tour so it picks up where you left off. - Butterfly now has an icon in the Dock. Click it to open Settings, right-click for Pause tiling and the tour. Turn it off in Settings › General › Show in Dock. - The strip map stays on screen longer after a swipe: 2 seconds by default, adjustable from 0.5 to 5 seconds in Settings › Strip & Windows › Map stays. - Meeting Privacy no longer covers a whole full-screen browser during a call. Glass stays only on private windows of the current Space and comes back when you return to the desktop.
